semantics.definition: An adult sexual-violence scene requires the authorial core to declare an unwanted sexual act, attempt, contact, or sexualized communication involving a specific adult target, lack of valid consent or consent produced by force, intimidation, fraud, coercion, threat, deception, incapacitation, abuse of power, or vulnerability, and a visible actor-to-target control relation. Clothing, affect, location, or intimacy alone never establishes consent or its absence.
